notes.title: ✨ Quality of Life Update – Tales of Miravia
notes.content:
🛠️ Recent improvements and fixes:

🔧 Multiple minor bugs have been fixed, enhancing the overall stability and polish of the game.

🎶 The visual equalizer effect is now also present on the title screen, adding more cohesive aesthetics.

⚔️ Combat flow improvement: when there is only one enemy or a single ally in battle, attacks, skills, and items will now be automatically executed, without needing to manually select a target.

🗣️ Text-to-speech has been re-implemented and is now fully fixed and functional, improving accessibility and immersion in the game.

💫 Thank you for continuing to explore the world of Miravia!

notes.title: ✨ Tales of Miravia - Patch Notes ✨
notes.content:
Thank you for being part of this magical journey!

⚙️ General Fixes & Improvements
🐞 Minor bug fixes.

⚙️ Visual effects optimization.

⚔️ Auto-battle now uses both attacks and skills automatically.

🔊 Volume balancing for smoother audio experience.

🎧 Subtle variations in repetitive sound effects.

🌈 Added a visual equalizer effect that reacts to map and battle music.

⚔️ Combat & Enemies
🗡️ The Deadly Shadow enemy now appears with a sword or axe in addition to the dagger.

👥 Improved enemy grouping logic. Repeating enemies are now labeled (e.g., Deadly Shadow A, B...).

⚡ Some battle animations have been enhanced.

⛅ Environmental Changes
☁️ More weather variety has been implemented across regions.

🏰 Tower of Martyrdom is Now Open!
12 new maps/floors added.

☠️ You no longer get teleported home upon death: a defeat message is shown, and you're returned to the title screen.

💾 You can load from your last save or autosave.

🖼️ Defeat screen visuals improved.

🧪 Free Demo Coming Soon!
A free and fully playable demo of Tales of Miravia is coming to Steam! Ideal for those who want to experience the game before purchasing. 100% free!

✍️ A Letter from the Developer
Hey everyone,

Today I want to share something a bit more personal — beyond the game itself. Tales of Miravia is not just a project to me, it’s a piece of my life. Many people don’t know this, but the game was paused for over a year… not for lack of ideas, but because of my health.

I have a genetic condition that affects my nerves. A while ago, I had spinal surgery, and I’m still recovering. It’s a chronic condition, with lasting effects I deal with every day. But even then, I never stopped dreaming. I kept going — slowly at times, unsure at others — but always with the hope of finishing what I started.

Tales of Miravia started as an experiment… and now it’s a game on Steam, with a community, with people playing it, sharing it, even making it their own. That fills my heart. It may not be perfect, but it’s honest. It’s built on effort, optimism, and a deep love for storytelling.

I’m deeply grateful to everyone who’s been with me on this journey:
To you, for playing, sharing, and supporting — and to my family, my unshakable pillar.

I’m open to all ideas, feedback, and suggestions.
This game is for everyone, and always will be.

Thank you for being here.
See you in the next updates…
And keep an eye out — new games are on the way!

With love,
LeashaDevGames

notes.title: 🛠 Tales of Miravia - New Update
notes.content:
A new breeze of change is blowing in Miravia! This version brings major quality improvements, more humor in the dialogs and tweaks that make your adventure more fluid, fun and visually stunning.

✨ Featured changes:

Complete rewrite of all dialogs in the game.
The texts now have more coherence and a more humorous tone, without leaving aside the essence of the story. Get ready to laugh while saving the world!

New interactions added!
Some new interactions have been added to the world to enrich exploration and bring more life to the environment - explore well, there are surprises in store!

Improved fluidity in important interactions.
Key scenes are now faster to activate. For example, it is no longer necessary to speak several times with the crystal to initiate boss fights: the interaction becomes automatic.

Temporary removal of the Text to Audio option.
Due to technical errors, this feature has been removed for the time being. We are evaluating its return in a future version.

⚔️ Balance and gameplay:

Animaforja enemy difficulty adjustment.
Reduced his stats to make the combat more balanced and fair.

Balanced Lishana's stats during the duel.
Adjustments were made to make the confrontation more even without losing intensity.

Reduction of chests, but with better rewards.
The number of chests in the game has been reduced, but now they offer much more valuable rewards. Every chest counts!

Cleaned up the post-battle grind system.
Unnecessary items have been removed from the reward system when winning battles, leaving only useful or truly valuable items.

More experience when fighting enemies on the map.
Now common enemies grant more experience, making advancing and leveling up more dynamic.

Clearer battle events with visual icons.
Now the pre-combat events have icons that will help you to quickly and visually understand their effects. Less text, more strategy!

🌬️ Important change: Elimination of Master Mode

It has been decided to eliminate Master Mode because it did not meet expectations and complicated the game development. The maps had variants of both modes, which generated difficulties when working and maintaining quality.

This change allows us to focus completely on the main mode: the Adventure, which will allow us to make more significant improvements and with better quality. In addition, the code has been optimized, improving the overall performance of the game.

For those who did not know the Master Mode, this was a mode where the characters started at the maximum level, but with mechanics that increased the difficulty in a not very pleasant way for the players.

What's new after this change:

The weather now changes dynamically depending on the game, with heavy thunderstorms, thunder, windy weather, fog and soft rain, accompanied by ambient sounds for greater immersion.

Indoor ambient sounds have been added, creating a richer atmosphere in each environment.

🎨 Visual improvements:

Reduced intensity of the flash effect when collecting coins.
Softer to the eye, especially when there are many coins nearby.

Corrected minor visual errors in the map.
Corrected graphical details to keep the overall presentation cleaner and nicer.

Thank you for continuing to follow this journey. Tales of Miravia continues to grow thanks to you, see you in the next update... and don't forget to talk to EVERYTHING that shines!

notes.title: 🌌 Tales of Miravia – “Echoes of Fate” Update
notes.content:
A new era of choices, mystery, and atmosphere unfolds in the heart of Miravia...

🔧 General Improvements
✅ Multiple minor bugs have been fixed, improving overall stability and performance.

📚 New basic interactions have been added in several libraries, enriching exploration and world-building for curious adventurers.

✨ Wishing Altar Visual Overhaul
The iconic Wishing Altar has received a full visual upgrade:

🎆 New mystical animations enhance its magical presence.

📝 Updated texts now provide a more immersive and clearer experience.

⚖️ Complete stat balancing for more rewarding and fair results.

🌅 Dynamic Lighting & Real-Time Clock System
Prepare to experience a world that adapts to your real-world time:

💡 A fully remade lighting system brings a richer, more atmospheric visual experience.

🕰️ Introducing a new dynamic time system:

If you play during the day, Miravia will be bathed in daylight.

If you play at night, shadows and mystery will take over the land.

🧭 A new interface displays the current in-game time in hours, minutes, and AM/PM, synced to your system clock.

⚔️ New Visual Effects in Battles
New combat effects have been added to enhance immersion, clarity, and cinematic style in every fight.

🌒 A New Mystery: Umbral the NPC
“Not all paths are written… some can be changed if you find the right shadow.”

Umbral, a mysterious figure, appears only at night in a hidden corner of Miravia.

He offers you a single chance to change the game’s difficulty mid-adventure.

In Master Mode, where difficulty selection is normally locked, this encounter breaks the system’s boundaries:

🎭 Your decision may make the game even harder or unexpectedly easier, going beyond what normal settings allow.

🌠 Thank You for Being Part of Miravia!
Your support, exploration, and feedback continue to help us shape this magical world.
Are you ready to hear the Echoes of Fate?

notes.title: ⚔️ Tales of Miravia - New update available
notes.content:
Hello adventurers of Miravia!

We are excited to announce that a major update for Tales of Miravia is now available. This version brings a huge amount of improvements, major gameplay changes, new mechanics, secrets and much more.
Below we leave you all the details. 👇

⚙️ General optimization and fixes
The game's performance has been significantly improved.

Many bugs reported by the community have been fixed.

Battles are now faster: action sequences and skills that were previously slow or heavy have been sped up.

🎨 Visual changes and graphical improvements
The appearance of enemies on the map has been redesigned, making them clearer and better integrated.

Character and NPC portraits have been completely redone in anime style!
The previous, more realistic version did not fit the visual style of the game.

Several maps have received visual and functional tweaks to improve the exploration experience.

📚 Expanded story
More dialogue has been added and the story has been extended, bringing more depth to the game's narrative.

🛒 Changes to the store and items
The skill store has been completely redone, it is now more intuitive and visually cleaner.

New items have been added to the game.

Martyrdom Tower rewards have been improved: they are now much more worthwhile.

🚫 Goodbye random encounters.... hello cheats!
We've completely removed the random encounter system, which generated too stifling an experience.

In its place, there is now a new system of visible traps on the map:

The player can always see their location and decide whether to avoid them or take the risk.

Some traps are healing and grant life regeneration for a limited time.

Enemies chasing you can trigger unavoidable battles if they reach you.

🧠 Interface and combat improvements
The battle interface has been improved, with cleaner and clearer design.

The HUD during combat sequences has been simplified.

The change of the level window in battle has been reverted, and now works correctly together with the level system on the map.

🎮 Master Mode changes
All 6 events are now available (previously only 4).

In this mode, the events are chosen randomly, increasing the difficulty considerably.

🔄 Changes to the difficulty selector before battle
Since a few versions ago, it is already possible to choose the difficulty at the start of the game, which made the selector before battle feel too easy or redundant.

Therefore, this system has now been modified:

It is no longer possible to choose anything that benefits your character before a battle.

You default to the difficulty you selected at the start of the game.

If you wish, you can add more difficulty through the pre-battle selector, to earn better rewards.

In addition, new debuffs have been added to the difficulty selector, which further complicate the fights for those who are looking for a real challenge.

🔊 Sound and ambience
New sound variations have been added when interacting with traps.

Traps now feature unique visual and sound effects.

🧩 Exploration and secrets
New secrets have been added throughout the world of Miravia.

Some are very well hidden... will you be able to find them all?

📜 Terms and conditions + invitation to content creators!
A new button has been added on the title screen that allows you to see the Terms and Conditions of the game.

We have added a special section for content creators.
We invite everyone who wants to record, review or share Tales of Miravia on their networks, regardless of platform or number of followers.

If you are a content creator, contact me by email! I'll be happy to send you a key and support you.

💌 Thank you for joining us
We would like to deeply thank all the players who have accompanied us on this journey.
Your comments, videos, reviews and messages inspire us to keep improving Tales of Miravia with every update.

This adventure is yours too!

- LeashaDevGames

notes.title: 📢 Tales of Miravia - New Update 24/03/25 🎉
notes.content:
🌀 Improved Spirit Modes.
We've made a number of improvements to the spirit modes to make them more dynamic and balanced. Here are the most important changes:

✅ Improved scalability: spirit modes now benefit more from the character's level and their TCR (Resource Growth Rate) stat.
✅ Optimized speed: The spirit bar fills faster, making the system more fluid and responsive.
✅ Improved Brightness: The spirit bar is now more visible and visually appealing.
✅ Adjusted requirements: Some modes are easier to activate, while others have been balanced to keep their power in check.

🏹 Spirit Modes and Upgrades.

🔹 Stoic (You gain spirit when taking damage).

Increased amount of spirit if you take a lot of damage.

The bar fills up faster and is easier to activate.

Scales better with your level and stats.

🔹 Conjurer (You gain spirit when using skills)

More spirit when using skills frequently.

More bonus at high levels.

Faster and better glowing bar.

🔹 Alchemist (You gain spirit when using items).

More spirit when using items frequently.

Progressive improvement with level.

More flashy and faster bar.

🔹 Striker (You gain spirit when performing critical hits).

More spirit when performing critical hits.

Faster and brighter bar.

Scales better with level and stats.

🔹 Warrior (You gain spirit when attacking and dealing damage).

Higher spirit if you deal damage in a single hit.

Bar faster and easier to activate.

Scales better with level and stats.

🔹 Assassin (You gain spirit when eliminating enemies).

More spirit when you eliminate enemies frequently.

Progressive improvement with level.

Faster and brighter bar.

🔹 Avenger (You gain spirit when an ally falls in battle).

More spirit if an ally is defeated.

Progressive improvement with level.

Flashier and faster bar.

🔹 Healer (You gain spirit when healing allies).

More spirit when healing large amounts of life.

Faster and brighter bar.

Scales better with level and stats.

🔹 Enchanter (You gain spirit when applying buffs or status effects to allies).

Increased spirit for long-lasting or powerful effects.

Faster and easier to activate bar.

Scales better with level and stats.

🔹 Boosted (You gain spirit when receiving buffs from allies).

More spirit when receiving powerful effects.

Faster and brighter bar.

Scales better with level and stats.

🔹 Reckless (You gain spirit when your health is low).

Higher spirit if life is very low.

Flashier and faster bar.

Scales better with level and stats.

🔹 Victim (You gain spirit when receiving debuffs from enemies).

More spirit when receiving powerful negative effects.

Faster and brighter bar.

Scales better with level and stats.

🔹 Dancer (You gain spirit when dodging attacks).

More spirit if you have high agility and dodge frequently.

Flashier and faster bar.

Scales better with level and stats.

💰 Improved Steal Skill.

🔹 Stealing random items: Enemies can steal a random item from you if you have available.
🔹 Visual effect: Added an on-screen shake effect when stealing occurs.
🔹 Messages: If you have no items, the enemy will fail the steal and a message will appear indicating the failure.
🔹 Adjusted difficulty: Enemies can steal more effectively, but if you have no items, the theft will be unsuccessful.

🎓 Enhanced Skill Mastery.

🔹 Reduced costs: Some skills now consume less MP, TP and HP when leveling up.
🔹 Improved bonuses: Adjustments to damage and duration of altered states to better balance the system.

⚠️ New Warning Messages

📌 When dying: A message appears reminding you to heal in Reginald's store.
📌 Flash effect: Activates when dying and returning to the house to improve the transition.
📌 Fast travel: Explanatory message when touching the fast travel button, indicating that the character is tired.

🐞 Minor Bug Fixes.

✅ Interface issues: Visual and interactive bugs were corrected.
✅ Event optimization: Increased fluidity in events and combats.
✅ Text bug fixes: Minor errors in game messages were fixed.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: Possible corruption of save files.

Due to recent changes, some old save files might be corrupted, causing crashes or unexpected errors.

📌 If you experience problems, follow these steps to do a clean install:

1️⃣ Close the game completely.
2️⃣ Go to the following location on your PC:

C:\Users_USER\AppData\Roaming\tales-of-miravia.

🔹 Replace “YOUR_USER” with your Windows user name.
3️⃣ Delete all the contents of the folder.
4️⃣ Open the game again.
5️⃣ Save your game to a new file to avoid future problems.




📌 Note: This will delete your previous save files. If you want to keep your progress, make a backup before deleting the folder.

🙌 Thank you for your support

We continue to work to improve Tales of Miravia and provide you with the best experience possible - see you in the next update! 🚀🎮

notes.title: 📢 Tales of Miravia - New Update 22/03/25 🎉
notes.content:
🔹 New Enemy: Zarzaeja
The Zarzaeja is a wild bee that dwells in the darkest, most forgotten corners of the forests. Its body is a dark, almost black shade, with small spikes on its abdomen that make it even more dangerous. Its flight is fast and erratic, making it an unpredictable threat. Though not deadly, its sting causes a burning pain and can paralyze those who face it. It usually acts alone but becomes even more aggressive if its nest is threatened.

New Features:

🔹 Removal of Old Battle Messages
All previous battle messages have been removed to make way for new, more dynamic messages that enhance the combat experience.

🔹 New Messages Added
A total of 500 new messages have been added, covering various aspects of character attacks, abilities, buffs, and debuffs.

🔹 Message Timing Optimization
The timing of combat messages has been optimized to be faster and more fluid, improving the overall experience and reducing waiting times during battles.

🔹 New Messages for Zephyra
Previously, Zephyra Cortavientos had no unique messages during her combo attacks. Now, 100 specific messages have been added for Zephyra, reflecting the speed and power of her wind-based combos. This brings more variety and personality to her actions in battle.

General Improvements:

🔹 Messages now adapt more fluidly and dynamically to character abilities, offering a more immersive experience.

🔹 Interaction with battle messages has been made more seamless to avoid interrupting the game’s pacing.

Download the update and keep enjoying Tales of Miravia with these improvements! ✨

notes.title: 📢 Tales of Miravia - New Update 21/03/25 🎉

Several major issues that could cause the game to freeze during battles have been resolved, ensuring a more stable experience.

🔹 Automatic Updates for Minor Fixes
If minor fixes that don’t require a full update are available, the game will automatically update itself.

Download the update and continue enjoying Tales of Miravia with these improvements! ✨

notes.title: 📢 Tales of Miravia - New Update 09/03/25 🎉
notes.content:
🔹 New Portraits for Main Characters
The portraits of the protagonists have been redesigned, giving them a fresh and improved look. Enjoy their new illustrations on your adventure!

🔹 Battle Event System Improvements

The "Activate Event" option has been replaced with "Select Event", giving you more control over battle effects.
A new option has been added: "Random Event", perfect for those who enjoy taking a gamble on luck.
A rebalance has been made to the strengths and weaknesses applied by these events to enhance gameplay.
🔹 New Legendary Item: Pure Soul Tonic

This item removes all malicious and beneficial states from a character, both in battle and on the map.
It does not remove effects from battle events or special mode.
It can only be purchased from Reginald's shop for 35 Draken.
🔹 Changes in Minigames and Tutorials

Minigame backgrounds have been improved, enhancing their visual appearance.
Tutorial messages have been adjusted for better clarity and understanding.
🔹 Removal of Campfires and the Speed Statue

Campfires have been removed, as their mechanics did not fully fit the overall gameplay.
The Speed Statue has been removed, since with the previous update that increased the base movement speed, it became unnecessary.
🔹 Change in the Soundtrack

Previously, the Normal Mode had a rock soundtrack, while Challenge Mode featured electronic music.
However, the electronic soundtrack did not fit well with the game's atmosphere, so it was decided to use rock music for both modes, offering a more cohesive audio experience.
Download the update now and continue your adventure in Tales of Miravia with these exciting new improvements! ✨

notes.title: 📢 Tales of Miravia - Update 07/03/2025 🎉
notes.content:
✨🔹 New Dungeon: Tower of Martyrdom
Take on a series of consecutive battles and challenge your skills to earn a special reward. Do you have what it takes to overcome it?

🔹 11 New Bosses!
Get ready for even more challenging fights with new enemies that will test your strategy:

Thalron
Abyssar
Nalrith
Solkhar
Dra'kaar
Zarith
Ryrana
Xalor
Morthas
Zharon
Morphés

🔹 Visual Improvements
✅ Cosmetic adjustments have been made to several maps.
✅ Battle backgrounds for the Eldoria Underground and House of Zephyra have been updated for greater immersion.
✅ Many in-game images have been improved in quality, including the title screen, for a better visual appearance.

🔹 New Progression Restriction
🔸 To progress to certain maps, you will now need to have specific characters in your party.
🔸 Previously, the game allowed you to progress with any number of characters, even just one or two, which broke the coherence of the story.
🔸 To improve the narrative, some areas will only be accessible if you have key characters in your party.
🔸 Good luck finding them all and saving Miravia!

🔹 Tutorial Improvements
📌 Changes have been made to the starting tutorial to make the options clearer and improve the experience for new players.
📌 When facing the first enemy, an option to watch the battle tutorial or skip it will now appear. This will allow players who are already familiar with the system to speed up the pace of combat.

🔹 Changes to the Teleportation System
🚀 Teleporters have been removed from most statues, leaving only the essential ones to access key plot locations.
🚀 To replace them, there is now an on-screen button, located next to the main protagonist's face, that will allow you to teleport to your home at any time.
🚀 This feature also serves to free the character if for some reason they get stuck and cannot move.

🔹 Changes to the Battle System
⚔️ The option to negotiate, fight or bribe at the start of battles has been removed to improve the pace of combat.
⚔️ Post-defeat and post-victory messages have been removed, as they were considered unnecessary and only slowed down the gameplay experience.

🔹 Optimization and Bug Fixes
💡 Overall game performance has been improved and several bugs fixed for a smoother experience.

Download the update and dive into new adventures in Tales of Miravia! ✨

notes.title: Tales of Miravia - Update 01/03/2025
notes.content:
This update does not change the game version.

The main text font has been changed.
Advanced item search has been removed, as it was unnecessary.
Treasure hunt mini-games on the map have been removed; instead, this mini-game is now found in the common chests.
Removed the smooth digit change animation when taking damage, as it could reduce the frame rate per second.
Enchanted shovel has been removed.
Minor adjustments have been made to some maps and events.
Several minor bugs have been fixed.
The game performance has been optimized.
